# Essential UI Pack (Swarve Studios): permission record

**Not covered by this repository's MIT licence.** The pack belongs to Swarve Studios. The permission below was given to this template's owner for the owner's own games. Anyone else who uses this template needs the pack and permission from Swarve Studios (Discord server "Stoxera", website swarve.lol).

- **Asset:** "Essential UI Pack - Swarve Studios" (`.rbxl`). Not in this public repository (`.gitignore`); put your own copy into this folder.
- **Request (owner, 2026-11-24):** use in a published Roblox game that earns Robux; modify and recolour it; use or re-upload its image and sound assets; credit wanted?
- **Answer (Swarve Studios support, 2026-11-25), verbatim:**
  > No problem at all, bro, you can really do whatever you want with it! As long as you don't resell them or charge money for them, you don't even need to credit me—though if you did, I'd appreciate it forever!
- **Granted:** commercial use in Robux-earning games, modification and recolouring, use and re-upload of its images and sounds. Credit optional (welcome).
- **Condition:** never resell the assets or charge money for them as such (no selling the pack or its images, sounds or UI as an asset, a model or a kit).
- **Optional credit:** "UI elements: Essential UI Pack by Swarve Studios".
